method_note: Census figures are Output Area counts assigned to the containing postcode district/sector via population-weighted OA centroids (point-in-polygon). Accurate at district level; coarser at sector boundaries. No LSOA apportionment was required (age band table TS007A is published at OA).
note: Census 2021 covers England and Wales only. No data available for Scotland (Census 2022 is published separately by National Records of Scotland).
